question: Can the same official Customs Service early20 page and HWP/PDF source contract used for 2018-2022 cover every held month 2023-01 through 2026-09, without using SOXX outcomes or selecting favorable vintages?

query_contract.list_parameters: startDate=YYYY-MM-20, endDate=YYYY-MM-27, srchWord=수출입, repCode=B00003, pageIndex=1 via urllib.parse.urlencode in this order
query_contract.candidate_rule: Among official-list pressReleaseView.do links with newsId, require queried month 1일~20일 or month.1-20 shorthand, 수출입 현황 and 관세청 in visible text; exactly one candidate advances. Zero/multiple remain unknown, no alternate query.
query_contract.attachment_rule: From a verified page collect unique fileId from official /common/download.do anchors with visible .hwp, .hwpx or .pdf filename; capture all at most four, no format preference or numerical version selection.

identity_gate: List/page HTTP200 HTML; page has the same newsId and early20 import-export title context; each linked attachment HTTP200 and expected HWP OLE/HWPX ZIP/PDF magic. Store unknown dates, errors and all versions without silent omission.
retention: Save exact list/page/attachment bytes, safe response headers, URLs, UTC receipt times and SHA under data/snapshots/kcs_early20_2023_2026_held_original_capture_20261023; one NAS archive per calendar year, remote hash and all-member cold restore. Keep 45-row status and receipts in native Qlib Recorder/NAS.
stop: Each month gets one official list query and at most one selected original page GET, no retry or alternate search. The current attachments do not certify historical first-public versions. No semiconductor number extraction, Qlib factor, model fit or Stage1 account in this capture version.
